title: Topic 2.2: Hadith on Etiquette of Eating

pages.lesson:
LESSON: HADITH ON ETIQUETTE OF EATING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.2: Hadith on Etiquette of Eating

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith on Etiquette of Eating. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What do you do before eating?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating
2. demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating
   In simple words: practise until you can read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   In simple words: practise until you can demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hadith on Etiquette of Eating using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hadith on Etiquette of Eating in the examples.
2. Explain Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.
4. Show that you can: read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on Etiquette of Eating using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on Etiquette of Eating important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read the hadith: “...Mention the name of Allah, eat with your right, and eat what is directly in front of you.” (Narrated by Al-Bukhari),
2. Role-play manners of eating,
3. Creativity and imagination: the skill of making connection is enhanced as learners role-play manners of eating.
4. Learning to learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge is enhanced as learners demonstrate the etiquette of eating with peers. Values:
5. Respect, for other learners while demonstrating etiquette of eating together.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do you do before eating?
2. What is the benefit of saying Bismillah while eating?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating
2. demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
